name: Caster Group

name: Angelic Blessing
description: Ignores each wound on a roll of 6+. Ignores each wound from a spell on a roll of 4+ instead.

name: Enhanced Angelic Blessing
description: If most models in this unit have Angelic Blessing, they always ignore shooting/charging wounds on rolls of 6+ from Angelic Blessing (instead of only when shot/charged from over 9 inches/6 inches away).

name: Bestial
description: The defender must re-roll unmodified Defense 6s.

name: Enhanced Bestial
description: If this model has Bestial, enemies taking hits from it must re-roll successful unmodified Defense results of 5-6 from Bestial (instead of only results of 6).

name: Buccaneer
description: When shooting enemies over 9 inches away, this model gets +1 to hit.

name: Enhanced Buccaneer
description: If this model has Buccaneer, it always gets +1 to hit rolls from Buccaneer (instead of only when shooting over 9 inches away).

name: Cursed Undead
description: Ignores each wound on a roll of 6+.

name: Enhanced Cursed Undead
description: If most models in this unit have Cursed Undead, they ignore wounds on rolls of 5-6 from Cursed Undead (instead of only on 6+).

name: Destroyer
description: Each of the defender's unmodified Defense rolls of 1 deals an extra wound.

name: Enhanced Destroyer
description: If this model has Destroyer, enemies always take wounds on unmodified results of 1 to block from Destroyer (instead of only when shooting/charging enemies over 9 inches/6 inches away).

name: Empyrean Spirit
description: Enemies shooting or charging this unit from over 9 inches away get -1 to hit.

name: Enhanced Empyrean Spirit
description: If most models in this unit have Empyrean Spirit, enemies attacking them always get -1 to hit rolls from Empyrean Spirit (instead of only when shooting/charging from over 9 inches/6 inches away).

name: Lucky
description: Each unmodified 6 to hit scores an extra hit.

name: Enhanced Lucky
description: If this model has Lucky, the target always takes hits on unmodified hit results of 6 from Lucky (instead of only when shooting/charging enemies over 9 inches/6 inches away).

name: Ossified
description: Hits on this unit from over 9 inches away count as AP reduced by 1, to a minimum of 0.

name: Enhanced Ossified
description: If most models in this unit have Ossified, hits they take count as having AP(-2) from Ossified (instead of only AP(-1)).

name: Royal Legion
description: Gets +4 inches range when shooting, and moves +2 inches on Charge actions.

name: Enhanced Royal Legion
description: If this model has Royal Legion, it gets +8 inches/+4 inches range when shooting/charging from Royal Legion (instead of only +4 inches/+2 inches).

name: Royal Warrior
description: Each unmodified 6 to hit scores an extra hit.

name: Enhanced Royal Warrior
description: If this model has Royal Warrior, it gets extra attacks on successful unmodified hit results of 5-6 from Royal Warrior (instead of only on 6).

name: Vale Oath
description: If this unit is Shaken at the start of the round, roll one die. On a 4+ it stops being Shaken.

name: Enhanced Vale Oath
description: If most models in this unit have Vale Oath, they stops being Shaken on rolls of 3+ from Vale Oath (instead of only on 4+).

name: Warden
description: Hits on this unit from over 9 inches away count as AP reduced by 1, to a minimum of 0.

name: Enhanced Warden
description: If most models in this unit have Warden, hits they take count as having AP(-2) from Warden (instead of only AP(-1)).

name: Wave-Step
description: When this unit is activated, it may place all its models anywhere fully within D3 inches of their position.

name: Enhanced Wave-Step
description: If this model has Wave-Step, it may move by up to 2D3 inches from Wave-Step (instead of only D3 inches).

name: Wild Veil
description: Enemies get -4 inches range when shooting this unit and -2 inches of movement when charging it (each to a minimum of 6 inches).

name: Enhanced Wild Veil
description: If most models in this unit have Wild Veil, enemy units shooting/charging it get -8 inches/-4 inches range to a min. of 6 inches from Wild Veil (instead of only -4 inches/-2 inches).
